event: Amazon's random price test on 68 DVDs (Aug 31-Sep 5) angers customers who suspect history-based pricing; refunds to 6,896 customers; Bezos: 'we never will test prices based on customer demographics'
structure: No body created; a CEO-level policy commitment that future test buyers automatically get the lowest test price

event: Merchant Fraud Squad (2000) merges with the Internet Fraud Round Table to form the Merchant Risk Council, a merchant-led fraud-prevention membership body
structure: External practitioner network where merchant fraud and payments staff share deviation patterns and practice

event: Five card brands launch the PCI Security Standards Council (Sept 2006), which takes ownership of PCI DSS; Visa keeps compliance enforcement and validation (AIS, formerly CISP)
structure: Card-network standards body writes merchant data-security rules; brands enforce

event: Two Amazon Marketplace sellers' repricing algorithms chase each other until 'The Making of a Fly' is listed at $23,698,655.93 (April 18); noticed by a Berkeley biologist, not by Amazon or the sellers
structure: None; prices fell back the next day with no reported rule or monitoring change

event: DOJ's first e-commerce criminal price-fixing case: David Topkins pleads guilty to coordinating Amazon Marketplace poster prices via pricing algorithms written to implement the agreement
structure: No structure inside firms; the DOJ Antitrust Division acts as the outside detector of algorithmic collusion

event: Amazon launches Project Zero (March): automated counterfeit protections, a self-service tool letting brands remove listings directly, and unit-level serialization; requires Brand Registry
structure: Monitoring system plus delegation of listing-removal decisions to brand owners

event: EU Platform-to-Business Regulation applies (12 July 2020): marketplaces must explain main ranking parameters and run a free internal complaint-handling system for business users with an annual report
structure: Mandated seller complaint system and public ranking-rule description; small platforms exempt

event: COVID-19 price gouging: Amazon removes 530,000 offers and later suspends 3,900+ US seller accounts under its Fair Pricing Policy, comparing seller prices with historic and off-Amazon prices
structure: Machine-learning price monitoring plus human review; works with state attorneys general

event: Amazon establishes the Counterfeit Crimes Unit (June 24) led by Cristina Posa, ex-DOJ computer crimes and IP counsel, staffed by former prosecutors, investigators and data analysts
structure: Dedicated investigative team for sellers who evade Amazon's listing rules

event: Robotic Industries Association publishes ANSI/RIA R15.08-1-2020, the first safety standard for industrial mobile robots in warehouses and fulfillment centres
structure: Industry committee standard for robot makers and integrators; conformance self-declared

event: Amazon says it changes Time Off Task to be averaged over a longer period and to monitor system failures rather than worker productivity; announced by logistics chief Dave Clark
structure: Executive-level rule change to a productivity metric; no standing body named

event: California AB 701 (signed Sept 2021) takes effect Jan 1: written description of every warehouse quota; quotas may not block breaks; workers can request their quota and work-speed data; Labor Commissioner enforces
structure: External enforcer plus mandated quota disclosure and data-on-request

event: China's algorithm recommendation provisions take effect (March 1): e-commerce operators bear primary responsibility for algorithm outcomes, must review algorithms technically and ethically, and may not use user traits for price discrimination
structure: Mandated internal algorithm review systems

event: European Commission makes Amazon's commitments binding (20 Dec): no use of seller data for retail, non-discriminatory Buy Box and Prime access, a second Buy Box offer, for 7 years
structure: Monitoring trustee with notification duties plus a centralised complaint channel for sellers and carriers

event: Amazon Store designated a very large online platform under the DSA (25 April); Article 41 requires an independent compliance function headed by a senior manager reporting to the management body; annual independent audit (KPMG); Amazon's challenge dismissed Nov 2025
structure: Head of compliance function plus external audit and audit-implementation reports

event: US INFORM Consumers Act takes effect (June 27): marketplaces must collect and verify high-volume sellers' bank, contact and tax data, suspend non-compliers and offer suspicious-activity reporting; first FTC enforcement against Temu (Sept 2025)
structure: Mandated seller-verification and reporting system

event: FTC complaint (less redacted Nov 2) alleges Amazon's 'Project Nessie' pricing algorithm raised prices where rivals would follow and was switched off during periods of outside scrutiny; trial set for Oct 13, 2026
structure: No disclosed governance body; on/off decisions internal and undisclosed

event: CNIL fines Amazon France Logistique EUR 32m (decision 27 Dec 2023, published Jan 2024): scanner-based productivity, inactivity (10-minute) and scan-speed (under 1.25s) indicators found excessively intrusive
structure: Regulator sanctions the monitoring system itself; triggered by press reports and employee complaints

event: Senate HELP Chairman Sanders report (Dec; Amazon disputes it) on Amazon injuries says internal 'Project Soteria' identified speed requirements as a major injury factor but yielded no meaningful policy change
structure: Internal study that noticed the deviation with no path to a rule decision

event: OSHA settlement with Amazon (Dec 19) resolving multi-site ergonomics cases: company-wide ergonomic risk assessments with annual updates and controls at all federally covered sites; $145,000 penalty
structure: Mandated corporate-wide ergonomic assessment system, enforceable in court

event: New York Warehouse Worker Injury Reduction Act signed (Dec 21; effective June 2025), extending the 2022 quota law: injury reduction programme covering pace, with employee involvement, and a qualified ergonomist to evaluate jobs
structure: Qualified ergonomist and injury reduction programme

event: Visa Acquirer Monitoring Program (VAMP) replaces the fraud (VFMP) and dispute (VDMP) programmes on April 1 with one card-not-present fraud-plus-dispute ratio; thresholds tighten in 2026 (sources disagree on figures)
structure: Card-network monitoring programme with fees, reserves and termination for merchants above thresholds

event: Instacart ends all item price tests and retailers' use of Eversight (Dec 22) after a Consumer Reports study found prices up to 23% higher for identical items; FTC inquiry reported
structure: No structure created; tests stopped by company decision

event: Bundeskartellamt finds Amazon's price control mechanisms for third-party sellers abusive (Feb 5; not final, Amazon to appeal); limits price controls to exceptional cases with transparency; about EUR 59m disgorgement
structure: Regulator sets the rule for when the platform may suppress seller offers

event: European Commission fines Temu EUR 200m under the DSA (May 28): its 2024 risk assessment relied on sector-wide data and underestimated illegal products; action plan due Aug 28, 2026
structure: DSA systemic-risk assessment system, reviewed by Commission and Board
